method: Same-date HE18 pairs over ~3 years of public prints. Dependence: Spearman rank correlation, co-spike frequency vs independence (lift), top-decile tail dependence. Basket: 7-day evening strip, 50 MWh/h on each grid, $150 strike, one shared $200k cap, priced off each hub's current gate-tested curve by Monte Carlo under an empirical seasonal copula, independence, and comonotonicity; compared with two separately capped legs of $200k each. The DE-LU leg is priced in EUR treated at par with USD for the illustration.

copula.note: Integer rank pairs (0..n-1) of same-date HE prints inside a ±45-day seasonal window across years; sample u=(k+U)/n per leg.
